title: El Salvador · Bitcoin Beach
text: On a later stay I took a room at the Punta El Zonte hostel, where the river meets the beach. That is Bitcoin Beach, where the phenomenon started. I woke before dawn to meditate, watched the surfers paddle out, and listened to the big round stones tumble every time a wave hit.

title: Burning Man Temple 2022
text: I painted the Temple series from my second visit to Burning Man. I photographed it in different light: blue and pink at night when the lights shifted, daytime sun, and at the end when it burned. The Temple is a cathartic place for a lot of people.

title: Bass Coast
text: I was at Bass Coast in Merritt, BC, with the ProVibers. We had danced all through the night, and by dawn we were at the downtempo tent, still hanging out as the sun came up. I had a couple of packs of bacon.

title: Ukraine
text: I painted these for an auction at my first art show and donated the proceeds to a Ukrainian family in need. My friend Val, who is Ukrainian, knew someone who could use the money. The paintings sold together, and we sent what we raised.

title: Sedona
text: All of my Sedona paintings are from a trip I took with my dad. He had heard about the energy vortexes there, and he was interested in consciousness and energy healing. The vortexes drained me and energized him.

title: Bitcoin Film Festival · Warsaw
text: I painted these for the Bitcoin Film Festival in Warsaw in 2026 and hung them in the gallery at the entrance to the theater. Tomek, who organized the festival, suggested the Hussar wings and the Bitcoin shield on the Syrenka, the protector spirit of Warsaw. The honey badger is often called Bitcoin's mascot.

title: Family
text: These paintings are of the people closest to me. Grandpa Howard was a saintly man and a machine-shop teacher; I painted him and three others for his memorial. One favorite shows my mom, Ruth, and Grandpa Howard with me as an infant, the first time he met me as a baby.

title: Cape Town
text: These come from a trip to Cape Town with my friend Gavin for the Adopting Bitcoin conference. On Table Mountain the clouds blew away while I meditated and revealed the bay far below. On my last day I watched the sunset from just below the peak of Lion's Head.

title: El Salvador · Past, Present and Future
text: I painted this triptych in 2022 with Chase Toole, after my first trip to El Salvador, right after the gangs were arrested. Nobody outside knew yet whether it would work out, and I wanted to show that tension. Past, Present and Future move from the bad years to a nation reborn to a new financial center.
